title: Halo Dental mission band
description: Full-width pure black section featuring an oversized warm amber-to-red horizontal gradient display headline, a rounded square team portrait slot on the left, and concise white body copy with a vermilion CTA button beside it.
notes: forces .dark by default so the black band and amber-to-red gradient headline contrast against neighbouring warm-stone sections
media slot accepts a square portrait image or element, defaulting to a token-styled architectural studio frame
